title: Head Comercial
description:
Head Comercial — Verde Equipamentos

Quando uma empresa já tem produto validado, mercado, demanda real, campanhas em andamento, CRM implantado e processos comerciais em funcionamento, o próximo salto não vem de improviso. Vem de arquitetura comercial.

A Verde chegou a esse ponto. Buscamos um Head Comercial para transformar uma base comercial já ativa em uma máquina de vendas previsível, inteligente e escalável.

SUA MISSÃO: Arquitetar a operação comercial da Verde. Nas primeiras semanas, atuar próximo da execução para entender a operação por dentro: a passagem dos leads pelo funil, a aderência ao processo de qualificação, a consistência dos registros no CRM, os critérios de priorização, a cadência de follow-up, o padrão de condução comercial e a integração entre marketing e vendas. A partir desse diagnóstico, estruturar a escala: processos sólidos, rotina de gestão, indicadores confiáveis, vendedores melhores, lideranças intermediárias, automações e IA aplicada.

O QUE TORNA ESSA VAGA DIFERENTE:A Verde vende máquinas de alto valor para quem quer construir, empreender, abrir fábrica, aumentar produção ou transformar um projeto de vida em negócio. Não é uma venda enterprise tradicional. O cliente vem de campanhas, WhatsApp, formulários, site, tráfego pago e redes sociais. O desafio é velocidade, qualificação criteriosa, confiança, condução consultiva e fechamento.

O QUE É INDISPENSÁVEL:

• Já ter sido Head Comercial ou responsável máximo por uma operação de vendas.

• Já ter estruturado, reestruturado ou profissionalizado uma área comercial.

• Dominar CRM, funil, forecast, cadência, indicadores e gestão de oportunidades.

• Vendas consultivas de alto valor geradas por leads digitais.

• Integrar marketing e vendas por dados reais: origem, qualidade, objeções, conversão e receita.

• Ter liderado times comerciais com rotina, acompanhamento e treinamento.

• Ter aplicado IA ou automações no comercial de forma prática (qualificação, priorização, análise de conversas, follow-up, produtividade, CRM). Usar IA apenas para escrever texto não é suficiente.

DIFERENCIAIS:

• Experiência com HubSpot ou Salesforce (ou outro CRM robusto). Valorizamos muito quem já operou esses sistemas a fundo — eles são centrais para nós.

• Lead scoring, automações comerciais e SDRde IA.

• Vivência em scale-up ou profissionalização comercial.

• Setor industrial, máquinas, construção, franquias ou venda de alto valor para pessoa física.

O PERFIL

CERTO: Um Head construtor: sabe desenhar processo, formar time, ler dados, usar tecnologia e transformar demanda em venda. Estratégico o bastante para arquitetar a máquina; próximo o bastante para enxergar onde ela ganha ou perde conversão.

UM FILTRO IMPORTANTE: Experiência apenas com grandes contas, multinacionais ou ciclos B2B corporativos longos pode não bastar. A operação da Verde exige lead digital, WhatsApp, CRM, velocidade, qualificação e venda consultiva para pessoa física empreendedora e pequenos empresários em decisão de investimento.

POR QUE ENTRAR: A Verde não está começando do zero — a matéria-prima já existe. O desafio é construir o sistema comercial que sustenta o próximo salto, com autonomia para desenhar processo, time e ferramentas. Esta vaga é para quem quer deixar legado, não apenas ocupar uma cadeira.

Local: Pindamonhangaba/SP R

Remuneração fixa entre R$ 8.000 e R$ 12.000 + variável agressiva por performance.

PARA SE CANDIDATAR, RESPONDA:

1. Você já foi Head Comercial ou responsável máximo por uma operação de vendas? Modelo, equipe e resultado.

2. Que operação comercial você estruturou, reestruturou ou profissionalizou na prática?

3. Qual sua experiência com venda consultiva de alto valor gerada por leads digitais?

4. Como você usa CRM, indicadores e forecast para comandar o comercial?

5. Como já aplicou IA ou automações para melhorar qualificação, produtividade, follow-up ou conversão?

Envie seu currículo respondendo às perguntas para - RH Verde Equipamentos.

title: Remote M&A Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising M&A or corporate law in private practice or in-house.
  • End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams.
  • Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics.
  • Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on.
  • Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

description:
Your Responsibilities:

  • Monitor project timelines and maintain responsibility for delivering accurate, on-time deliverables.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Provides exceptional customer service and adheres to the Lockton philosophies

Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree required

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel required; experience with Power BI strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data manipulation or automation preferred, but not required
  • Excellent written and spoken English proficiency required, given regular collaboration with international, multi-lingual stakeholders
  • Familiarity with survey methodology best practices, including question design and sampling.
  • Awareness of data privacy principles and regulations relevant to survey data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) a plus

description:
Job Purpose:

Gerenciar a carteira de contratos públicos da Cipla Brasil no âmbito federal (Ministério da Saúde — DLOG, EBSERH, IGESDF, órgãos militares) e nas regiões Sul, Centro-Oeste, Norte e Nordeste, assegurando a conversão de contratos assinados em empenho, entrega e faturamento, além de renovar contratos vigentes e expandir a carteira por meio de novas licitações nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal. Posição estratégica de acesso direto ao poder de compra federal, incluindo a maior conta pública da companhia.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1 Execução e Conversão de Contratos (prioridade): converter contratos assinados em empenho, entrega e faturamento; prioridade máxima na renovação do contrato; orquestrar o fluxo licitação → empenho → entrega → recebimento; resolver gargalos logísticos, documentais e de pagamento.

2 Gestão de Contas do Setor Público: gerenciar o relacionamento com Ministério da Saúde, IGESDF, EBSERH, SES GO/RS/PR/SC, Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (AM), consórcios (CISVARC) e fundos estaduais (FUNSAUDE, FES); ser o ponto de contato principal com órgãos federais.

3 Renovação e Expansão: antecipar vencimentos (90/60/30 dias) e conduzir renovações — parede de vencimentos 2026; prospectar novas licitações; elaborar propostas (Lei 14.133/2021); manter cadastros atualizados nos portais.

4 Gestão Comercial e Previsão de Demanda: consolidar forecast de 12 meses com precisão mínima de 75%; monitorar LBE.

5 Negociação e Rentabilidade: negociar preços dentro do ambiente regulado; monitorar preços de referência e margens por contrato.

6 Inteligência de Mercado: monitorar cenário político e orçamentário federal; acompanhar concorrência; alimentar a liderança com insights.

Perfil Profissional Desejado:

Formação: ensino superior completo em Farmácia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA (diferencial).

Experiência: mínimo de 10 anos em gestão de contas-chave na indústria farmacêutica com vivência comprovada no setor público; experiência em órgãos federais e licitações de grande porte; experiência em laboratórios indianos (desejável); vivência em modelo PJ (diferencial).

Habilidades: conhecimento profundo de compras públicas federais e estaduais; relacionamento institucional com o governo federal; orientação a resultados em ciclos longos; comunicação persuasiva; disponibilidade para viagens extensas; inglês desejável.

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
SC — Regional Sales Representative

Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development

Position Details

Job Title: SC — Regional Sales Representative

Department: Sales & Business Development — LATAM

Reports To: Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM

Location: Santa Catarina, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)

Role Overview

The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.g., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines.

Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations.
  • Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory.
  • Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards.
  • Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments.
  • Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel.
  • Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities.
  • Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities.
  • Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company.
  • Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information.
  • Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the IoT segment.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Customer-Centric: Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.
  • Location: Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, LoRa, satellite communication, and antennas.
  • Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil.
  • Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial IoT, or connected mobility verticals.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and standard productivity software.
  • Spanish language skills a plus.

About Quectel

Quectel is a global IoT solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and IoT connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.

With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (IoT platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.

Life at Quectel LATAM

At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.

  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in IoT modules.
  • Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
  • Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams.
  • A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.

Industries & Applications

Quectel's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:

  • Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions.
  • Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility.
  • Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking.
  • Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring.
  • Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring.
  • Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility.
  • Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security.

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications.
  • Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.
  • Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure.
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).

Explore Quectel — Links & Resources

We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.

Company & Careers

Company Website: — Global IoT solutions provider

Quectel Careers: quectel.com/about-quectel/career — Open roles across the Quectel ecosystem

Quectel News & Press: quectel.com/news-and-pr — Latest company announcements

Acceleronix (Ecosystem Affiliate): — IoT platform and connectivity services

Follow Us on Social Media

LinkedIn: Quectel Wireless Solutions — Company updates, job posts, industry news

YouTube: Quectel on YouTube — Product demos, tech talks, and event highlights

Technical & Developer Resources

Quectel Developer Zone: developer.quectel.com — Docs, SDKs, tools, and developer support

Product Selector: quectel.com/product-selector — Browse the full portfolio of IoT modules and antennas

Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

A operação brasileira está em expansão e a área de RH está ganhando escala, então quem chega agora acompanha esse crescimento de perto.

A empresa tem compromisso público com diversidade e inclusão. Este time está sendo formado com profissionais PCD desde as primeiras contratações, junto com a construção da área.

title: Auditor de TI e Riscos Tecnológicos
description:

Se você é uma pessoa movida a desafios e determinada a fazer a diferença. Faça parte da nossa equipe!

• Apoiar projetos de compliance e aderência a frameworks e normas de mercado.

Formação Acadêmica

title: Revenue Accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.

You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.

What You Will Own

  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing
  • Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment
  • Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables
  • Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar
  • Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause
  • Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances
  • Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number
  • Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements
  • Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution
  • Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas
  • Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and RevOps on deal structuring and billing questions
  • Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle

What We're Looking For

  • 4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting
  • Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion
  • Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements
  • Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause
  • Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, or equivalent)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant
  • Availability for US time zone overlap

Preferred

  • SaaS, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics
  • Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or NetSuite ARM
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company
  • Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit

Why Join MAVI?

  • Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first
  • Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer
  • Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies
  • Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders
  • Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles
  • Flexible remote-first work culture
  • Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026

About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.

This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.

How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.

What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets

  • Design static ad systems for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization

  • Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself
  • Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.

You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems
  • Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it
  • Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area
  • You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team
  • A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves

  • Motion design or animation
  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. "It looked great" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.

What We Offer

  • Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually
  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product

How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

  1. Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  2. One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked.
  3. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Music
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Music Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in music will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse music-related topics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering music theory, genres, composers, artists, music history, production, instruments, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Music, Music Theory, Musicology, Ethnomusicology, Music Education, Music Production, Audio Engineering, Performing Arts, or other music-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of music, including music theory, composition, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music history, production techniques, notation, and contemporary music trends.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in music education, performance, composition, music production, journalism, research, content creation, audio engineering, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate music-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across diverse musical topics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of music theory, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music production, and music history.
  • Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

description:
Descrição de Cargo: Mecânico de manutenção de máquinas pesadas

Objetivo do Cargo:

Executar manutenções preventivas, corretivas e preditivas em frotas e equipamentos pesados de linha amarela e transporte (tratores, pás carregadeiras, retroescavadeiras, escavadeiras e caminhões).

Garantir a máxima disponibilidade operacional dos equipamentos no processo de movimentação, carregamento e armazenagem de fertilizantes, respeitando as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança do trabalho.

Principais Responsabilidades:

• Manutenção Preventiva e Corretiva: Diagnosticar, reparar e substituir componentes mecânicos, hidráulicos, pneumáticos e elétricos de máquinas de linha amarela e caminhões da planta.

• Operação de Sistemas Didáticos e Diagnóstico: Utilizar rastreadores e ferramentas de diagnóstico eletrônico para identificar falhas em motores a diesel, transmissões automáticas/powershift e sistemas hidráulicos de alta pressão.

• Preservação Contra Ambientes Agressivos: Executar inspeções e aplicação de tratamentos protetivos em chassis, articulações e conectores elétricos expostos ao pó e à corrosão severa de fertilizantes (como ureia, KCI e fosfatos).

• Testes e Liberação: Realizar testes de rodagem, aferição de pressão de sistemas hidráulicos e regulagens técnicas antes da liberação final do equipamento para a operação.

• Registro e Controle: Preencher ordens de serviço (OS) em sistema de gestão da manutenção (CMMS/SAP/TOTVS), detalhando causas, peças aplicadas e horas trabalhadas.

• Segurança e Organização: Cumprir rigorosamente procedimentos de LOTO (Bloqueio e Etiquetagem) durante manutenções, manter a oficina limpa e zelar pelo descarte correto de óleos e fluídos contaminados.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo + Curso Técnico em Mecânica, Electromecânica ou Manutenção de Automotores.

Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos atuando com manutenção de máquinas pesadas (linha amarela e caminhões).

Conhecimentos Técnicos: Leituras de esquemas hidráulicos e elétricos; manutenção de motores a diesel; sistemas de freio e transmissão. Certificações & CNH CNH categoria D ou E; Certificação para operação de máquinas (desejável NR-11 e NR-12).

Diferencial: Experiência anterior em indústrias químicas, de fertilizantes, mineração ou agronegócio.

Competências Comportamentais:

• Foco em Segurança: Rigor inegociável com normas de proteção individual e coletiva.

• Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade para investigação estruturada de causaraiz de falhas mecânicas.

• Proatividade e Agilidade: Resposta rápida a paradas não programadas para evitar gargalos na produção/embarque.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. This is not a traditional accounting role — you will carry the close for US clients and own real areas of their books in a fast-moving environment.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Accountant, you will run the day-to-day accounting for US clients, reporting to the client's Controller or finance lead.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will see the close from first accrual to final statement and own the parts that are usually spread across three people, with a US finance lead reviewing your work and available when a call needs to be made above your level. It suits someone who wants to carry a full set of books rather than process a queue within them, and who fixes a broken process rather than working around it each month.

What You Will Own

  • Carry end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients on a defined close calendar
  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, with accountability for cycle time and the quality of what you deliver
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed asset schedules, and month-end adjustments, with support attached
  • Prepare financial statements under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers you produced
  • Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and drive ageing items to resolution rather than reporting them
  • Maintain the supporting schedules behind the balances — prepaid amortisation, accrual detail, fixed asset registers, deferred revenue rollforwards
  • Handle and review AP, AR, payroll accounting, and cash reporting for accuracy and correct coding
  • Prepare variance analysis with root-cause commentary, in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Act as a day-to-day US client contact, building strong working relationships with their finance team

title: Editor SEO (Slots)
description:
Vaga de Editor de Slots

Você assume o conteúdo de slots da Cardmates Brasil. Review de jogo, página de provedor, guia de mecânica, glossário, notícia de lançamento, ranking, tudo passa pela sua mão antes de ir ao ar. Quem lê tem que sentir que o texto foi escrito por alguém que já girou o jogo, não por alguém que traduziu a descrição do provedor.

No dia a dia

Você escreve e edita os textos da vertical de slots. Reviews dos jogos que o brasileiro mais roda, com sessão real, rodadas contadas, bônus ativado e o que o jogo entregou na prática, não o que o provedor promete. Páginas de provedor, da Pragmatic e da PG Soft até o estúdio que acabou de entrar no mercado. Guias de mecânica, Megaways, cluster pays, hold and win, compra de bônus, e o glossário pra quem está começando. Cobertura de lançamento, o ranking dos melhores caça-níqueis, comparativos, e o texto de apoio das lives de slots. Crash game, tipo Aviator e Mines, entra no mesmo pacote.

Boa parte do trabalho é revisar o material dos redatores. Você corrige RTP errado, volatilidade chutada, recurso copiado de outro jogo e aquela história de slot pagando e horário bom pra jogar, que não existe. Corta enrolação e devolve com feedback que a pessoa entende. Confere se o ganho máximo bate com a ficha do provedor, se a compra de bônus custa o que está escrito, se a faixa de aposta é a que aparece no jogo em real e não a da planilha em inglês. Leitor que joga percebe na hora quando o texto foi escrito por quem nunca abriu o jogo.

SEO faz parte do pacote. Você monta a pauta olhando intenção de busca, estrutura o texto pra ranquear e atualiza review antigo que perdeu posição. IA entra no fluxo pra ganhar velocidade, mas o texto final não pode ter cara de IA. Isso aqui a gente leva a sério.

O que você precisa

Conhecimento sólido de slots, de mecânica a matemática. Você sabe por que dois jogos com o mesmo RTP se comportam de um jeito completamente diferente e não precisa consultar nada pra explicar. Português afiado e texto limpo, com experiência real de edição e revisão. Noção prática de SEO, não só teoria de curso. Organização pra tocar pauta, prazo e vários textos andando ao mesmo tempo. E jogo de cintura pra dar feedback sem desmotivar o time.

title: Domain Expert Reviewer - History
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified History Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in history will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse historical topics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering ancient, medieval, modern, and contemporary history, civilizations, historical events, political history, military history, archaeology, historiography, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in History, Archaeology, Classics, Cultural Studies, Anthropology, Humanities, or other history-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of history, including familiarity with major historical periods, events, civilizations, political and social movements, notable figures, and cultural developments across one or more regions or periods.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in historical research, academia, education, journalism, publishing, museums, archives, historical content development, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to assess historical information, chronology, sources, and context accurately.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Head of Accounting
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.

We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.

The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.

You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

  • The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors.
  • Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.
  • Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

  • Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual.
  • Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.
  • External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

  • The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.

Team, Systems, and Standard

  • Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.
  • A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Rippling, or FloQast
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

  • Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat
  • Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI
  • Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

  • The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced.
  • Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on.
  • Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review.
  • Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

  • Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you.
  • Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller.
  • External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations and Team

  • The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast.
  • The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or Rippling
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

  • Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them
  • Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI
  • Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

  • Communicate professionally with the 4ARC team regarding open items, missing documentation, and accounting issues.
  • Support multiple clients while meeting established deadlines and maintaining confidentiality.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of accounting experience preferred.

  • Experience with bank reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and financial statement preparation.

Definir critérios de projeto, especificações técnicas e requisitos construtivos para obras geotécnicas. Atuar tecnicamente nas fases de engenharia conceitual, básica, detalhada e de suporte à construção. Avaliar e aprovar

documentos técnicos elaborados por empresas projetistas e consultorias especializadas. Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de suprimentos, construção, comissionamento, operação e manutenção. Acompanhar a implantação das obras em campo, garantindo aderência aos projetos, normas técnicas, padrões corporativos e requisitos legais. Identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos geotécnicos que possam impactar segurança, prazo, custo e desempenho dos empreendimentos. Participar da gestão de mudanças de engenharia, análise de não conformidades e

definição de ações corretivas. Elaborar e revisar relatórios técnicos, pareceres de engenharia, memoriais de cálculo e documentação para órgãos reguladores. Atuar na gestão de contratos de engenharia, construção, consultorias e serviços especializados. Coordenar interfaces entre disciplinas de engenharia, construção, operação, meio ambiente, licenciamento e segurança. Propor melhorias técnicas e inovações voltadas à segurança, confiabilidade operacional, redução de riscos e otimização de custos. title: Analista de Geoprocessamento
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Geoprocessamento para atuar com inteligência geográfica, análise e tratamento de dados geoespaciais, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas junto à Operação. Esse profissional será responsável por transformar dados geográficos em informações qualificadas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão Gerencial, garantir a atualização cadastral dos ativos da Regional, garantindo a confiabilidade das informações nos sistemas da companhia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coletar, tratar, analisar e validar dados geoespaciais provenientes de diferentes fontes, como GIS, imagens de satélite, GPS, drones, bases cartográficas e sistemas corporativos.

  • Elaborar mapas temáticos, mapas técnicos, dashboards geográficos, relatórios, gráficos e layouts cartográficos para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Executar análises espaciais para diagnóstico, identificação de padrões, modelagem territorial, modelagem de redes, definição e delimitação de áreas de atuação, bem como estudos de rotas.
  • Realizar georreferenciamento de imagens, pontos de interesse, redes e ativos de infraestrutura.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e plataformas de geoprocessamento, como ArcGIS, QGIS, AutoCAD Map e demais soluções geoespaciais.
  • Apoiar projetos de universalização, regularização cadastral, gestão patrimonial, planejamento de investimentos e iniciativas relacionadas ao saneamento, meio ambiente e desenvolvimento urbano.
  • Integrar informações geográficas com indicadores operacionais, comerciais, regulatórios, patrimoniais e de engenharia.
  • Apoiar equipes multidisciplinares na elaboração de estudos, projetos e soluções baseadas em inteligência geográfica.
  • Aplicar normas técnicas, ambientais e legais relacionadas ao uso e à gestão de dados geoespaciais.
  • Participar de iniciativas de transformação digital, automação de processos e governança de dados geográficos.
  • Apresentar análises, estudos, indicadores e resultados geoespaciais em reuniões técnicas e executivas, apoiando o acompanhamento de projetos e a tomada de decisão.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Cartográfica, Engenharia de Agrimensura, Geografia, Geoprocessamento, Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental, Tecnologia em Geoprocessamento ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas de Informações Geográficas (SIG/GIS).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de geoprocessamento, preferencialmente ArcGIS.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI integrado a dados geoespaciais.
  • Conhecimento em análise espacial, cartografia e georreferenciamento.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados geográficos e manipulação de dados espaciais.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Obrigatório Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) Categoria B.

Competências desejadas

  • Visão analítica e pensamento sistêmico, transformando dados geográficos em informações estratégicas para o negócio.
  • Proatividade, inovação e foco em melhoria contínua dos processos e da qualidade dos dados.
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a governança das informações.
  • Capacidade de relacionamento e trabalho colaborativo com equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com geodatabases, PostgreSQL/PostGIS ou SQL Server.
  • Experiência com automação utilizando Python para geoprocessamento.
  • Conhecimento em sensoriamento remoto, imagens de satélite e drones.

title: Advogado(a) de Contratos Sênior
description:
Sobre a posição

Estamos buscando um(a) Advogado(a) de Contratos Sênior para integrar nosso time jurídico e atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das áreas de negócio da companhia.

Essa é uma posição para quem combina sólida experiência em Direito Contratual, visão de negócio e capacidade de transformar desafios jurídicos em soluções práticas, seguras e alinhadas aos objetivos da empresa .

O profissional terá atuação próxima às áreas de RH, Comercial, Compras, Excelência Operacional, Operações, B2B, B2C e demais áreas corporativas , além de interação frequente com fornecedores, parceiros comerciais e escritórios jurídicos.

Buscamos alguém com perfil consultivo, protagonista e orientado à solução , que tenha facilidade para transitar em um ambiente dinâmico, de alta volumetria e múltiplos stakeholders, com autonomia para conduzir negociações e recomendar caminhos jurídicos que equilibrem proteção da companhia, gestão de riscos e viabilidade do negócio .

É uma oportunidade para quem deseja compreender profundamente o negócio e contribuir para sua evolução por meio de soluções jurídicas consistentes e pragmáticas.

Principais responsabilidades

· Atuar de forma estratégica na elaboração, análise, revisão e negociação de contratos , avaliando cláusulas e estruturas contratuais, identificando riscos, oportunidades e alternativas jurídicas , sempre considerando o contexto e os objetivos do negócio;

· Atuar como parceiro(a) das áreas internas, oferecendo aconselhamento jurídico consultivo, claro e orientado à tomada de decisão ;

. Conduzir e apoiar negociações com fornecedores, clientes, parceiros comerciais e demais contratantes, buscando soluções que conciliem os interesses da companhia e a segurança jurídica;

· Atuar em contratos relacionados a locação, exploração de garagens e espaços, sociedades, consórcios e demais estruturas jurídicas necessárias à operação/condução dos negócios ;

. Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos contratos, que poderá envolver além da elaboração de contratos, seus respectivos aditivos, distratos, notificações, instrumentos de garantia e demais documentos jurídicos relacionados às relações contratuais;

· Apoiar as áreas de negócio na estruturação jurídica de novas iniciativas e na definição de estratégias para demandas com potenciais impactos jurídicos;

· Contribuir para o fortalecimento e a aplicação de políticas de integridade, compliance e governança relacionadas às relações contratuais;

· Interagir com escritórios jurídicos parceiros em questões contratuais que demandem atuação judicial ou suporte especializado;

· Participar de reuniões e negociações em português e eventualmente inglês , inclusive com interlocutores internacionais;

· Elaborar, revisar e responder comunicações e documentos jurídicos em inglês;

· Traduzir questões jurídicas complexas em recomendações objetivas, claras e aplicáveis ao negócio ;

· Contribuir para a evolução dos processos, ferramentas e modelos de trabalho da área jurídica, incluindo o uso de tecnologia e Inteligência Artificial aplicada à rotina jurídica .

O que buscamos

· Graduação completa em Direito e OAB ativa ;

· Trajetória profissional sólida de no mínimo 10 anos na área contratual;

· Vivência em ambientes de alta volumetria, dinamismo e múltiplas demandas simultâneas ;

· Experiência em contratos corporativos e atuação próxima a diferentes áreas de negócio;

· Capacidade de compreender o contexto comercial das demandas e propor soluções jurídicas pragmáticas e orientadas ao negócio ;

· Inglês avançado, com segurança para participação em reuniões, negociações e elaboração de documentos;

· Conhecimento em gestão de riscos contratuais, integridade e compliance ;

· Facilidade e interesse no uso de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas ao Direito ;

· Perfil colaborativo, organizado, analítico e com forte capacidade de comunicação e negociação ;

· Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo híbrido 4x1 , na região de Itaim Bibi/Vila Olímpia .

Será considerado diferencial

· Pós-graduação ou especialização em Direito Contratual, Empresarial ou áreas correlatas ;

· Experiência em empresas dos segmentos de varejo, serviços, locação, operações, shopping centers, estacionamento ou negócios com estruturas semelhantes;

· Experiência com contratos envolvendo locação, exploração de espaços, consórcios, sociedades e operações B2B e B2C ;

· Vivência na estruturação jurídica de novas operações e projetos;

· Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos com forte interação entre Jurídico e áreas de negócio .

title: Analista de design
description:
Analista de Design (Pleno)

Sobre a Vesti

A Vesti é uma plataforma que conecta confecções do mercado de moda a lojistas multimarcas, facilitando e digitalizando o processo de vendas no atacado. Atendemos confecções que buscam expandir suas vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com seus clientes lojistas através de uma solução tecnológica pensada para o setor.

Sobre a vaga

A Vesti está em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Design Pleno para atuar no time de Marketing, apoiando a criação de materiais digitais, impressos e audiovisuais.

Buscamos alguém com experiência em social media, materiais gráficos e edição de vídeos curtos, com olhar criativo, senso estético e atenção aos detalhes para transformar briefings em peças claras, atrativas e alinhadas à identidade da marca.

Principais atividades

  • Criar peças para redes sociais, como posts estáticos, carrosséis, stories, capas de reels e thumbnails.
  • Desenvolver materiais para campanhas digitais, incluindo criativos para mídia paga, e-mails, WhatsApp, banners e landing pages.
  • Criar e adaptar materiais impressos, como folders, flyers, banners, cartazes, adesivos, apresentações, materiais para eventos e peças comerciais.
  • Editar vídeos curtos para redes sociais, motion design, campanhas e conteúdos institucionais, incluindo cortes, legendas, trilha, transições e ajustes visuais.
  • Adaptar campanhas para diferentes formatos e canais, mantendo consistência visual e clareza na comunicação.
  • Preparar arquivos para impressão, considerando sangria, margem de segurança, resolução, CMYK e fechamento em PDF.
  • Organizar arquivos, templates e versões finais dos materiais de marketing.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com design para social media, materiais impressos e edição de vídeos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva e ferramentas de edição de vídeo.
  • Conhecimento em formatos para Instagram, LinkedIn, stories, reels, campanhas digitais e materiais gráficos.
  • Noções de fechamento de arquivo para impressão.
  • Boa noção de tipografia, composição visual, cores, hierarquia de informação e identidade de marca.
  • Organização para lidar com demandas simultâneas, revisões e prazos.
  • Boa comunicação para trocar com o time de marketing, comercial, e áreas envolvidas.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido, com 2 dias presenciais por semana em São Paulo.
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência prévia atuando diretamente com social media (gestão de conteúdo, calendário editorial ou produção para redes sociais).
  • Trazer ideias de melhorias, novos formatos de conteúdo e tendências de design e redes sociais, contribuindo ativamente com sugestões para o time de marketing.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, organizada, comunicativa e ágil, com bom olhar visual e cuidado com acabamento.
  • Alguém que consiga transitar entre design digital, impresso e vídeo, criando materiais bonitos, funcionais e estratégicos para apoiar as ações de marketing da Vesti.
  • Valorizamos especialmente um perfil proativo, curioso e antenado em tendências, que não espere apenas por briefings, mas que traga ideias próprias, sugira novos formatos e ajude o time a explorar novas oportunidades criativas e de conteúdo.
  • Também é importante que tenha facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, conduzir ajustes com clareza e participar da rotina híbrida do time, com presença no escritório 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo.
  • É necessário enviar portfólio junto com a candidatura para participar do processo seletivo.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
GERENTE DE QUALIDADE - MULTINACIONAL DO SEGMENTO AUTOMOTIVO DE GRANDE PORTE
